FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Sole Revival Shoe Store & Repair, we specialize in providing quality footwear and expert shoe repair services to our community. Our operations focus on retail sales of a wide selection of shoes, including athletic, casual, and formal styles, as well as accessories. We pride ourselves on our repair services, which include resoling, heel replacement, and other maintenance tasks carried out by skilled technicians. Our store is designed to create a welcoming atmosphere for customers, with a clean and organized layout that meets local safety codes. We ensure that all repairs are conducted using non-hazardous materials, minimizing risk and ensuring a safe environment for both our staff and customers. Additionally, we maintain a strong safety record with ongoing staff training in operational procedures to further enhance safety and efficiency in our services.

Our shoe store offers a variety of footwear for sale, and we also provide a rental service for specialized shoes, such as those for sports events or formal occasions, to meet our customers' needs.
